Keys.title: AI Provider Keys
Keys.subtitle: Saouti is 100% BYOK (Bring Your Own Key). Your key is stored encrypted and only used for your generation runs.
Keys.keyPlaceholder: Paste your Gemini API key (e.g. AIzaSy...)
Keys.saveSuccess: API key validated and securely encrypted.
Keys.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove your API key? Generation will be disabled until you add a new one.
Keys.noKeyBanner: Add your Gemini API key to start writing.
Keys.guideTitle: How to get a free Gemini API key
Keys.step1Desc: Go to aistudio.google.com and sign in with your Google account.
Keys.step2Desc: Click 'Get API key', then click 'Create API key in new project'.
Keys.step3Desc: Copy your generated key and paste it here in Saouti.
Keys.freeTierNoticeBody: Google's free-tier terms state that prompts and responses may be reviewed by human reviewers and used to improve Google products. Paid tiers do not permit model training.
Keys.providerTermsLink: Read Google API Terms of Service
Keys.consentCheckbox: I understand that free-tier API keys may permit Google to review and use data per their terms.
Keys.emptyUsage: No AI calls recorded in the last 7 days.

Documents.uploadSubtitle: Enrich your voice profile with up to 5 PDF documents (CV, bio, articles, brochures).
Documents.privacyModalSubtitle: How Saouti handles your uploaded documents
Documents.privacyPointKey: Processed via your own AI provider key. We never send your documents to third-party model accounts.
Documents.privacyPointStorage: Stored in an encrypted, isolated private volume accessible only to your authenticated account.
Documents.privacyPointDelete: You maintain complete ownership. Deleting a document or your account permanently purges the files and text immediately.
Documents.dropzonePrompt: Drag and drop a PDF file here, or click to browse
Documents.dropzoneHint: Max 10 MB and 20 pages per document. Password-protected files are not supported.

Documents.invalidFormat: Invalid file format. Only PDF files are supported.
Documents.encryptedPdfError: This PDF is password-protected. Please upload an unlocked version.

Documents.tooManyPages: Document exceeds maximum page limit of 20 pages ({count} pages found).

Documents.scannedUnsupported: This document contains scanned images, but your configured AI key does not support direct document OCR.
Documents.reviewDrawerSubtitle: The Profiler extracted these details from your document. Review each item before it is added to your profile.
